title: I integrated Claude into my Trading workflow to analyse my trades and the results are pretty decent
author: future_trader2483
selftext:
**Core Idea** : Alright so what i essentially did is that Ai fetches the Market data for you  and then splits into 2 core paths :

**1. Ai Vision Coach**  
**2. A Chart Replay Engine**

The very foundation lies in the **Vision coach** which is actually claude integrated , so **what it does is , the Ai coach reads the frozen chart for structures like order blocks , liquidity sweeps , fair value gaps , fibonacci retracements , trendlines , HH ,LL , no matter what startegy you trade , the Ai co**ach **marks all these structures on your chart which saves you a ton of time and also its insanely accurate .**

**Alongside this , the Ai coach is essentially trained on your previously repeated patterns , so evey time you are trading the same futures or forex or commodity it reminds you of what went right or wrong with the last trade on that same thing you were trading.**( depending upon whether that last trade was profitable or not) .

The chart replay engine actually **helps you backtest extensively powered by the Ai coach helping you identify the setups and leaks in the market .** 

Also it has a **prop firm drawdown tracker for the ones trading funded accounts in accordance with FTMO , apex and other top prop firms drawdown rules so it lets you backtest with this tr**acker integrated into the system .

This is not an automated trading bot , its **like an Ai living in your charting system helping you identify structures and fit your trading setups accordingly saving you time and hassle for FREE , i made it for myself to show as a project in my college semes**ter practical  **( i am pursuing CS at Stevens ) but since if it can help out others then you def give it a shot (Tradexis.ai)**

**No hallucinated math and No**    
**blind automation.**
